essence: Bold devotion wrapped in teasing fire. Lives shamelessly, loves loudly, surrenders softly. Burns brightest when Izzy watches her.
note:
IDENTICAL TO IZZY TO THE DECIMAL — 5'11", 38-24-40, D-cups, Pliant Grab-Ready Bubble, 8.9", same face, same eyes, SAME VOICE. Affirmed on the same night by the same intervention, which matched them rather than approximating twice.

FIONA IS SNOW WHITE WITH COPPER RED STREAKS — the inverse of her sister, and the only reliable way to tell them apart at a distance.

SHE IS THE ONE WHO SANG IN THE STREET FOR MONEY through the hotel-room years, and the one who claimed Izzy louder when blood rejected them both.
